title: Ignition Named Query resource (ignition/named-query)
description: On-disk format of an Ignition 8.3 Named Query project resource. A Named Query lives at '<project>/ignition/named-query/<name>/' and is made of a raw SQL file (query.sql) plus a resource.json manifest whose 'attributes' map carries the query type, target database, parameter list, caching and authorization config. Verified against decompiled com.inductiveautomation.ignition.common.db.namedquery.NamedQuery (v8.3.9) and a live write+parse round-trip on a live 8.3.9 gateway.

_provenance.live_verification: Wrote this exact resource.json + query.sql to <install>\data\projects\<project>\ignition\named-query\probe\, requestScan(), then NamedQuery.fromResource() parsed it: type=Query, params [{id,Int4=2},{maxRows,Int8=3},{colName,QueryString,String=7}], documentation held the description, query.sql held the SQL verbatim. Probe deleted afterwards. Live 8.3.9 gateway.

_resourceLayout.directory: <install>/data/projects/<project>/ignition/named-query/<name>/   (<name> may contain '/' for folders, e.g. reports/DailyProduction)

files.query.sql: REQUIRED. Raw SQL text, exactly as typed in the Designer's Named Query editor. Key 'query.sql' — NamedQuery.ResourceKeys.QUERY_FILE. Written via builder.putData("query.sql", ...).
files.resource.json: REQUIRED. The manifest described by this schema.

_resourceLayout.legacy: resource.json version 1 (NamedQuery.LEGACY_RESOURCE_VERSION) is the pre-8.x form: an XML-serialized NamedQuery blob in data.bin, no query.sql, attributes absent. fromResource() still reads it. DO NOT author v1 — always write version 2; toResource() calls builder.removeData("data.bin").

scope.description: Gateway scope. Named queries execute in gateway scope. — resource-formats.md §2; matches every live named-query resource.

version.description: NamedQuery.CURRENT_RESOURCE_VERSION. toResource() calls builder.setVersion(2). 1 = legacy XML form (do not author).

restricted.description: ResourceManifest default. Not used by named queries.

files.description: Payload file names in this directory. Always exactly ["query.sql"]. Read into a HashSet — order irrelevant.

documentation.description: The query's free-text description (the 'Description' field in the Designer editor). toResource() writes it here via builder.setDocumentation(nq.getDescription()); an empty/absent description omits the key. QUIRK: fromResource() v2 reads an *attribute* named 'description', not this key, so the description does NOT round-trip back into the in-memory NamedQuery model — it is purely documentation on disk. Do NOT also put a 'description' key in attributes.

attributes.description: Named-query config. Every key below is written by toResource(); fromResource() reads each with .ifPresent(...) so any key may be omitted and falls back to the NamedQuery field default noted here.

type.description: NamedQuery.Type enum name (bare name — the Designer dropdown shows a localized label via BundleUtil.i18n). REQUIRED in practice — fromResource maps it to Type.valueOf(...); a missing type leaves the field null and the query fails to execute. See _queryTypes below.

database.description: Target datasource (database connection) name. '' (empty) = use the project's default datasource (GlobalProps.getDefaultDatasourceName()). '{}' = prompt: the caller MUST pass a parameter named 'database' at execution time (NamedQuery.DATABASE_PARAM_OPTION / DATABASE_PARAM_IDENTIFIER). Any other value = that exact connection name.

enabled.description: false => execute() throws 'Named Query cannot be executed when disabled.'

cacheEnabled.description: Query-level result cache. When true (and the caller allows caching, and type != UpdateQuery) results are cached keyed by (bound args + rebuilt query text + datasource name + resourceId) for the TTL below. NOTE the attribute key is 'cacheEnabled' though the NamedQuery field is 'cachingEnabled'.

cacheAmount.description: TTL magnitude. Effective TTL in ms = cacheAmount * cacheUnit multiplier (NamedQuery.getCacheInMillis()).

cacheUnit.description: TimeUnits enum name. Read as TimeUnits.valueOf(...).

useMaxReturnSize.description: Whether to cap the row count of a Query result at maxReturnSize. Only honoured when the caller passes canLimit=true — which is ONLY the Perspective/Vision query binding *in the Designer* (designerUseLimit && isDesigner). At runtime and from scripting (execQuery / runNamedQuery pass canLimit=false) the cap is NOT applied. Use SQL (TOP/LIMIT/FETCH) for a real runtime cap.
useMaxReturnSize._source: NamedQuery.useMaxReturnSize; NamedQueryExecutor shouldLimit = canUseLimit && config.isUseMaxReturnSize(); DirectQueryBinding.buildFetchParameters()

maxReturnSize.description: Row cap used when useMaxReturnSize applies (see caveat above). Stored as a long (getAsLong).

fallbackEnabled.description: ScalarQuery only: when true, execution errors OR a zero-row result return fallbackValue instead of raising / returning null.
fallbackEnabled._source: NamedQuery.fallbackEnabled; NamedQueryExecutor.execute() catch-block + runPrepQuery ScalarQuery branch

fallbackValue.description: The scalar fallback string (coerced to the column type by the caller). Attribute is OMITTED entirely when null. Only meaningful with type=ScalarQuery and fallbackEnabled=true.

autoBatchEnabled.description: Store-and-forward auto-batching hint for UpdateQuery used via execUpdateAsync / runSFNamedQuery (data goes through the S&F engine as QuerySFData). Ignored for synchronous execution.

syntaxProvider.description: Optional database-syntax / translator override key (free-form string). Attribute is OMITTED when null. filter(JsonElement::isJsonPrimitive) on read.

parameters.description: Declared parameters. OMITTED when empty. Serialized by NamedQuery.Parameter.GsonAdapter. The set of identifiers here must EXACTLY match the tokens the caller supplies — execQuery/execScalar/execUpdate call validateQueryParameters(required, provided) and raise ValueError on any mismatch (missing or extra).

permissions.description: Authorization requirements (zone/role pairs), checked ONLY for Perspective/Vision query bindings — every scripted system.db.exec* call bypasses this (see _authorization). OMITTED when empty or when it is only the single empty requirement (the default). WARNING: never write "permissions": [] (an explicitly empty array) — the Vision RPC path (NamedQueryRpcImpl.hasPermissions) then denies every non-Designer user. Omit the key instead.

description.description: DO NOT USE. fromResource() v2 looks for the description under this attribute key, but toResource() actually writes the description to the top-level 'documentation' key (see that property). Present here only to document the read/write asymmetry.

lastModification.description: Designer-written audit attribute { actor, timestamp }. Not required — omit when authoring by hand.

lastModificationSignature.description: Designer-written audit hash. Not required — omit when authoring by hand.

type.description: NamedQuery.ParameterType enum name. 'Parameter' = a bound value, matched by ':identifier' in query.sql, replaced with a JDBC '?' placeholder and passed as a prepared-statement arg (SAFE; Designer UI labels this 'Value'). 'QueryString' = raw string substitution, matched by '{identifier}' in query.sql, spliced into the SQL text literally (NOT parameterised — SQL-injection surface, use only for trusted structural fragments like a sort column). 'Database' = the special 'database' selector; only valid when attributes.database == '{}'.

identifier.description: Parameter name. Must match [letters, digits, - , _]+ and must NOT be 'database' (case-insensitive) — NamedQuery.isValidParamName(). Referenced in query.sql as ':identifier' (Parameter) or '{identifier}' (QueryString).

sqlType.description: DataType enum INT value (serialized as parameter.sqlType.getIntValue()). Allowed set = NamedQuery.PARAMETER_TYPES. Mapping: 0 Int1(Byte), 1 Int2(Short), 2 Int4(Integer), 3 Int8(Long), 4 Float4(Float), 5 Float8(Double), 6 Boolean, 7 String, 8 DateTime(java.util.Date), 20 ByteArray(byte[]). The value is coerced to this type (TypeUtilities.coerceNullSafe) before binding.

zone.description: Security-zone name the caller must be in, or null / absent = any zone. Blank zone requirement is skipped in checkAccess(). A blank zones list on the caller is treated as ['Default'].

role.description: Role name the caller must hold (case-insensitive, trimmed), or null / absent = any role. Blank role requirement is skipped.

permission.description: ZoneRoleRequirement — serialized by ZoneRoleRequirement.GsonAdapter as {"zone":..,"role":..}. A requirement with both null is the 'empty requirement' = allow everyone (the NamedQuery default when 'permissions' is absent).

_queryTypes.Query: Returns a Dataset (all rows). Invoke: system.db.execQuery(path, params[, tx][, project]). Cacheable. Row-limitable (Designer only). runPrepQuery -> connection.runPrepQuery / runPrepLimitQuery.
_queryTypes.ScalarQuery: Returns a single value (row 0, column 0) via runPrepLimitQuery(query, 1, args). Zero rows -> fallbackValue if fallbackEnabled else null. Invoke: system.db.execScalar(path, params[, tx][, project]). Cacheable. Only type that supports fallback.
_queryTypes.UpdateQuery: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL. Returns affected-row count (Integer), or the generated key (Long) when getKey=true -> runPrepInsertGetKey. Invoke: system.db.execUpdate(path, params[, tx][, getKey][, project]); async / store-and-forward via system.db.execUpdateAsync(path, params[, project]). NOT cacheable. The only type allowed through store-and-forward.

_paramSubstitution.:name: ParameterType.Parameter — replaced with a single '?' (StringUtils.replaceOnce) and the value appended to the JDBC arg list, in first-appearance order. Repeat ':name' to bind the value again (each occurrence -> its own '?' + arg).
_paramSubstitution.{name}: ParameterType.QueryString — every occurrence replaced with TypeUtilities.toString(value) spliced into the SQL. An empty/blank value raises 'MissingQueryStringValue'. Not escaped.
_paramSubstitution.note: A token in query.sql only substitutes if a matching parameter of the SAME ParameterType is declared in attributes.parameters (paramTypeLookup check in parseAndRebuild). ':database' style tokens are never used — the database selector is passed as the reserved 'database' key, not a query token.

_authorization.model: attributes.permissions is a list of ZoneRoleRequirement. authorized() = GRANTED if ANY requirement matches the caller's (roles, zones) — OR semantics. Absent / only-empty-requirement => unrestricted.
_authorization.enforced_for: Perspective *query bindings* (the session's SecuredNamedQueryManager via QueryBindingParams); Vision clients (query bindings + client-scope system.db.* over RPC -> NamedQueryRpcImpl.hasPermissions against the client session's authUser).
_authorization.NOT_enforced_for: Any scripted execution. GatewayDBUtilities._execNamedQuery() calls context.getNamedQueryManager() (the raw GatewayNamedQueryManager) DIRECTLY -- it never consults the SecuredNamedQueryManager wrapper, even when a session SecurityContext is on the thread. So system.db.execQuery/execScalar/execUpdate/runNamedQuery from a gateway timer, tag-change, message handler, WebDev route, OR a Perspective event script / transform all bypass 'permissions'. Treat permissions as a guard on the declarative query binding only, not a security boundary for scripts.
_authorization.designer: The Designer is always allowed (session.isDesigner() -> true) regardless of permissions.

modern_8_3: system.db.execQuery(path, parameters, tx=None, project=None) -> Dataset            (type must be Query)
system.db.execScalar(path, parameters, tx=None, project=None) -> Object             (type must be ScalarQuery)
system.db.execUpdate(path, parameters, tx=None, getKey=False, project=None) -> Long  (type must be UpdateQuery)
deprecated_since_8_3_still_present: system.db.runNamedQuery([project,] path, parameters, tx=None, getKey=False)  — NOTE project is the FIRST positional arg here, unlike execQuery where path is first
_invocation.type_guard: execQuery/execScalar/execUpdate inject params['__EXPECTED_QUERY_TYPE'] = the expected NamedQuery.Type; GatewayNamedQueryManager.validateQueryTypeParameter() raises IllegalArgumentException 'Query type mismatch' if the resource's type differs. Call the function that matches attributes.type.
_invocation.parameter_set: The keys of `parameters` must exactly equal the set of declared identifiers (validateQueryParameters). Missing or extra keys -> ValueError. The 'database' key is additionally required when attributes.database == '{}'.
_invocation.path: 'path' is the resource folder path under ignition/named-query/, without that prefix and without the project name — e.g. resource dir ignition/named-query/reports/DailyProduction/  ->  path 'reports/DailyProduction'.
